what: Minimum-wage path for the forecast years - the ONE source read by FR1 (exogenous 'minwage', every scenario) and FR3 (its baseline path and scenario default).
first_forecast_year_rule: annual average (months / 12) of the level in force under the decree schedule minwage_decrees.csv (DSK table 004_1); no decree after 2025-01-01, so 2026 = the legal 400 AZN
growth_note: Assumption (no decree exists beyond 2025): 2027-2030 nominal growth a year = FR3's documented scenario levers (Baseline 6%, Adverse 3%, Reform 9%), now shared by FR1. Before 2026-10-06 FR1 used 2025 x 1.05 (420 AZN in 2026) and +5% a year in every scenario, while FR3 used 400 AZN then 6/3/9%.
